description.zh:
用于临时暂停整个站点的代理加速功能，开启后所有DNS记录都将直接返回记录值给客户端。取值范围：
- true：暂停站点加速。
- false：站点正常加速。

当暂停站点加速时，仅支持 NS 接入的已激活站点。
description.en:
Specifies whether to temporarily pause the proxy acceleration feature for the entire site. After the feature is paused, all DNS records directly return record values to the client. Valid values:
- true: Pauses site acceleration.
- false: Resumes normal site acceleration.

When site acceleration is paused, only activated sites with NS access mode are supported.

description.zh: 站点ID，可通过调用[ListSites](~~2850189~~)接口获取，并根据 Status 字段 确认站点的状态，及 AccessType 字段确认站点的接入方式。
description.en: The site ID. You can call the [ListSites](~~2850189~~) operation to obtain the site ID. Check the Status field to confirm the site status and the AccessType field to confirm the access mode of the site.

descriptions.zh: 该API仅允许接入模式为“NS模式”的站点调用。
descriptions.en: This API operation can be called only for sites that use the NS access mode.
